name: Rossy AI Lead Automation Connector
author: rossyai

sections.description:
Rossy AI Lead Automation Connector lets you connect your WordPress forms to the Rossy.AI service.

Key features:
– Configure connectors per form (Formidable Forms, Contact Form 7).
– Map form fields (or static values) to API keys.
– Use per-form or shared API tokens.
– View delivery results in an Activity Log.

Service disclosure

This plugin acts as a connector to an external service (Rossy.AI). By entering a valid API token and saving a connector, you consent to send mapped form data to the configured Rossy.AI API endpoint. Please review the service Terms of Use and Privacy Policy before enabling.

  • Rossy.AI: https://rossy.ai/
  • Terms: https://rossy.ai/terms
  • Privacy: https://rossy.ai/privacy

Privacy and data handling

  • This plugin does not track users or send data externally unless you explicitly configure and activate a connector.
  • Database logs store delivery status and may include target email and a short message. IP storage can be disabled:
    • Define ROSSYAI_FF_COLLECT_IP as false or use the rossyai_ff_collect_ip filter to return false.

JavaScript and CSS

All JavaScript and CSS are enqueued using WordPress APIs. No external code is executed.

Internationalization

  • Text domain: rossy-ai-lead-automation-connector
  • Domain Path: /languages
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Go to Rossy AI Lead Automation Connector in the admin menu to create a new connector.
  4. Select your form, enter your API token, and map form fields to API keys.
sections.faq:
Does this work without Formidable or CF7?

Not at this time. One of those form plugins is required.

Where are logs stored?

  • Database logs are stored in custom tables for review in the Activity Log page.
